answer_2.quote: Experimental results indicate that STEPCO consistently outperforms baselines. STEPCO achieves an average accuracy of 92.3 across eight mathematical reasoning benchmarks after a single iteration... We evaluate STEPCO on eight mathematical reasoning benchmarks and extended it to open-domain question answering and commonsense reasoning tasks... In open-domain QA tasks, such as the HotpotQA dataset, we use exact match (EM) and F1-score, and use accuracy for other tasks.
